limitations: No concrete bug found in the declared transmit IR: UDP/IPv4 fixed layout, lengths, pseudoheader, checksum default/disable/computed-zero, and ID=0 atomic semantics are consistent with RFC768/RFC791/RFC1122/RFC6864 and the pinned fixed-address TTL64 DF1 profile within reviewed scope.
Review is static over the supplied IR/profile/spec excerpts only; runtime execution, native C codec, and PCAP gate are not independently verified.
Scope exclusions (receive/decode, ARP, routing, PMTU, options, fragmentation, dynamic binding, physical/Linux peer) are not assessed and any behavior there is unspecified.
Payload >1472 is explicitly uncovered; TRANSMIT guard rejects it, but that boundary is outside verified acceptance.
Checksum primitives are trusted as specified (modulo pack, end-around 16-bit complement, zero padding for odd final octet); their independently implemented correctness is not proven here.
Absence of findings does not constitute a correctness proof or acceptance claim; only that no concrete bug was identified in the declared slice.
